source: Written for this app. The idea is the `marks` slot of the user-supplied mirror-selfie prompt that became anatomy_bank.json's `inventory-selfie` template - CLAUDE.md records it as 'the highest-value idea in any of the five prompts: evidence, not imperfection'. Until this bank it existed only as worked-example prose inside that one template; no builder could write it into a prompt. NOT AI Video Bootcamp course material.
note: Every option is a small detail that only exists because something happened before the shutter: a dent from sunglasses just taken off, hairs shed on the cushion it slept on, a ring where the bottle stood wet. Random imperfection reads as noise; an imperfection with a CAUSE reads as a moment that really happened, which is what a generated image lacks. This is descriptive spec content like wardrobe or posing, NOT a ninth realism layer: it rides spec['overrides']['evidence'], which build_prompt.free_overrides() appends to the free trailing segment, so prompt_bank.json and realism_lint.py stay untouched and adding evidence can only ever ADD keywords to a prompt, never remove one. capture_bank.json's `evidence` group is the CAMERA's evidence (a tilted horizon, flash falloff); this bank is the SUBJECT's. Phrases are comma-joinable fragments with no terminal full stop and no negation, because build_compact() comma-joins them and realism_lint.is_negated() would otherwise discount a keyword sitting near a 'no'.

sunglasses-dent.label: Sunglasses dent
sunglasses-dent.phrase: a faint pink dent on the bridge of the nose from sunglasses just taken off
sunglasses-dent.note: Tells you she was outside a minute ago. Nobody adds this unless they were there.

hair-tie.label: Hair tie on the wrist
hair-tie.phrase: a hair tie worn around the wrist, pressing a slight ridge into the skin
hair-tie.note: A thing a real person carries all day. The ridge is what makes it worn rather than placed.

strap-crease.label: Bag-strap crease
strap-crease.phrase: a soft crease across the shoulder of the top where a bag strap sat all day
strap-crease.note: Fabric remembers. A garment straight off the hanger is a costume.

watch-tan.label: Watch tan line
watch-tan.phrase: a faint paler band on the wrist where a watch usually sits
watch-tan.note: Weeks of sun in one detail. Works best on a bare wrist in a warm setting.

slept-hair.label: Hair flattened on one side
slept-hair.phrase: hair slightly flattened on one side, as if just up from leaning against something
slept-hair.note: The opposite of a salon blow-dry - the head was resting somewhere a moment ago.

cold-flush.label: Flush from the cold
cold-flush.phrase: a faint flush at the tip of the nose and across the cheeks from just coming in out of the cold
cold-flush.note: Uneven colour with a reason. Pair with a winter coat or a doorway.

ink-smudge.label: Ink on the hand
ink-smudge.phrase: a small blue ink smudge on the side of the hand from writing
ink-smudge.note: Proof of an activity outside the frame. Good for desk, study and office scenes.

lint.label: Lint on a dark sleeve
lint.phrase: a few stray light fibres of lint caught on the dark sleeve
lint.note: Dark fabric always collects something. A spotless black sleeve is a render.

shed-hairs.label: Shed hairs on the cushion
shed-hairs.phrase: a few shed hairs left on the cushion it was just lying on
shed-hairs.note: The surface remembers the animal. Strongest on a dark or contrasting fabric.

damp-nose.label: Freshly licked nose
damp-nose.phrase: a slightly damp, freshly licked nose catching a pinpoint of light
damp-nose.note: A living detail, a second old. Close and mid shots only - invisible at a distance.

bent-whisker.label: One bent whisker
bent-whisker.phrase: one whisker bent at an angle from pressing against something
bent-whisker.note: Breaks the perfect symmetrical fan generators love.

flattened-fur.label: Fur flattened from sleeping
flattened-fur.phrase: a flattened patch of fur on the side it was sleeping on
flattened-fur.note: The coat holds the shape of the last thing it did.

groomed-tufts.label: Damp grooming tufts
groomed-tufts.phrase: a few damp, spiky tufts of fur where it has just been grooming
groomed-tufts.note: Uneven, wet-looking fur in one small patch - a cat that was washing a moment ago.

dusty-paws.label: Dust on the paws
dusty-paws.phrase: a faint dusting of grit on the paws from the windowsill
dusty-paws.note: Where it has been. Works with any indoor-outdoor setting.

thumbprint.label: Thumbprint on gloss
thumbprint.phrase: a faint thumbprint smudge on the glossy surface
thumbprint.note: Someone picked it up. The single fastest way out of the floating-product look.

water-ring.label: Dried water ring
water-ring.phrase: a faint dried water ring on the surface beside it where it stood wet
water-ring.note: Evidence on the SET, not the product - the bottle has a history on this counter.

label-lift.label: Label edge lifting
label-lift.phrase: the label edge lifting very slightly at one corner
label-lift.note: Subtle wear. Keep it slight on a hero product shot - this is used, not damaged.

dust-edges.label: Dust on the top edges
dust-edges.phrase: a fine film of dust settled along the top edges
dust-edges.note: Time passing on a shelf. Not for a brand-new product launch.

scuffed-base.label: Scuffed base
scuffed-base.phrase: light scuffs around the base from being set down many times
scuffed-base.note: Use over and over, told by the one part nobody looks at.

just-opened.label: Cap just put back
just-opened.phrase: the cap sitting slightly off-centre, as if just opened and put back
just-opened.note: Turns a packshot into a moment in a routine.

worn-path.label: Worn path in the floor
worn-path.phrase: a worn, slightly paler path in the floor where people always walk
worn-path.note: Years of use in one line across the frame.

left-mug.label: Half-finished mug
left-mug.phrase: a half-finished mug left on the side with a ring beside it
left-mug.note: Somebody was just here and will come back.

sun-fade.label: Sun-faded curtain
sun-fade.phrase: one side of the curtain faded paler where the sun hits it every afternoon
sun-fade.note: A room that has existed for years, not minutes.

scuffed-wall.label: Chair-height scuffs
scuffed-wall.phrase: faint scuff marks on the wall at chair height
scuffed-wall.note: Where the chair always bumps. Lived-in, never dirty.

corner-leaves.label: Leaves blown into the corner
corner-leaves.phrase: a few dry leaves blown into the corner by the door
corner-leaves.note: The outside gets in. Seasonal - autumn and winter scenes.
